Dream 2026-11-22 linked 10 vignettes from 2 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-27 · retells · "we need to make sure that we are able to present some kind of coherent view" (The generic editor is many people's first experience of SRS, and muSrs must present a coherent view there: data first, tools after (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-27 · touches · "musrs has no working structure so any change is an improvement" (Settled navigation stays stable; it grows consistently and only significant redesigns come up for PR (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-27 · touches · "We ned a useful tree that allows us to make sense of what is in the repository" (Navigating the meaning stored in a repository is an essential job of SRS (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-30 · retells · "I cannot understand them at all" (Vignette 2026-10-30: I cannot understand these repos in srs-web; the three columns may be the wrong start)
- 2026-10-30 · retells · "Right now human readability has been lagging behind." (Vignette 2026-10-30: readability by humans and AI with intact semantics is the core offering)
- 2026-10-30 · retells · "A human using srs must be able to have a view that makes sense." (Vignette 2026-10-30: meaning must be available; a repository specifies how it is seen; packages define the editors and renderers)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "see if it makes reading these repos easier by default" (Vignette 2026-10-30: default to the Read view, as an experiment in reading by default)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "find a top level introduction and then drill down into parts" (Vignette 2026-10-30: research is a tree of documents that gets deeper)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "We have recently spent time discussing how to structure a repo for humans." (Vignette 2026-10-30: ongoing research into SRS use, findable from context)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "What different ways can we experiment with making repositories readable." (Vignette 2026-10-30: interactive experiments over mockups; prototype relation traversal in the interface before core and spec)
